dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Could you help me, please?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. kʊd juː ˈhɛlp miː, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. What can I do for you?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈwʌt kən aɪ ˈduː fər juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like to transfer some money to my friend in Canada.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə trænsˈfɜːr sʌm ˈmʌni tə maɪ ˈfrɛnd ɪn ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. The currency in Canada is the Canadian dollar.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ðə ˈkɜːrənsi ɪn ˈkænədə ɪz ðə kəˈneɪdiən ˈdɑːlər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Could you explain the exchange rate?
dialogue.reading: kʊd juː ɪkˈspleɪn ði ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌreɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Today, one Canadian dollar is about twenty-four baht.
dialogue.reading: təˈdeɪ, ˈwʌn kəˈneɪdiən ˈdɑːlər ɪz əˈbaʊt ˌtwɛnti ˈfɔːr ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, can you say that again, please?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, kən juː ˈseɪ ðæt əˈɡɛn, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. One dollar is twenty-four baht. I can write it down for you.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈwʌn ˈdɑːlər ɪz ˌtwɛnti ˈfɔːr ˈbɑːt. aɪ kən ˈraɪt ɪt ˈdaʊn fər juː.
